_comment: Optional site-wide config. Copy this file to assets/config.json and edit values. settings.json takes precedence over user-edited localStorage values; users can still override at runtime via the home-screen Settings block.
_gmapsKey: Google Maps Embed API key. With this set, every stop view embeds a live Google Map; otherwise the view falls back to a tap-to-open static preview. Restrict the key's HTTP referrer to your deployed origin (e.g. https://rollroyces.github.io/buseta-hk/*).
_vapidPublicKey: Phase 42 — VAPID public key for Web Push service-disruption alerts. Base64url-encoded. Optional until a push server is wired up; without it, the Settings → Service alerts toggle saves a subscription but the server has no way to deliver pushes (the UI surfaces this as 'waiting for server'). See docs/push-notifications.md for the server-side checklist.
